'''G'nooks''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]], [[Ape/Legends|ape]]-like [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]]. They were known for their lack of intelligence, which some postulated was due to their very small [[Brain/Legends|brain]]. While attending the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Dagobah Tech]] school in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], the young [[Adventures of a Jedi Prince|Jedi Prince]] [[Ken]] learned of the g'nooks as a part of his study of [[Biologist/Legends|exobiology]]. Indeed, when Ken took the Dagobah Tech aptitude tests, several of the exobiology questions concerned that species. Accordingly, the Jedi Prince considered the test so ridiculous that only a g'nook could have designed its questions.<ref name="MMY" />

==Behind the scenes==
The g'nooks were mentioned in the [[1993]] novel ''[[Mission from Mount Yoda]]'', the fourth book of the [[Adventures of a Jedi Prince|''Jedi Prince'']] series written by [[Paul Davids|Paul]] and [[Hollace Davids]].<ref name="MMY" />
